title: UHI_STRUCTURE: analysis code for the empirical structure of the air-temperature urban heat island
description:
Analysis code for the empirical structure of the air-temperature urban heat island: how its level scales across cities, how its trend moves within a city over time, and how the two separate by element and by region.

The code reads two published data records and derives everything else — the within-city epoch panels, the level-model fits, the robustness suite and the display items. It contains no data of its own.

Version 1.1 adds the supplementary analyses of the manuscript “Bigger cities have larger heat islands, denser ones do not, and growing ones get hotter” (regional-gap designs, building volume and land cover, the seasonal split, and the interval helpers), which read the files added to the companion record.

Requires the air-temperature UHI record (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22006932) and the companion city panels (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22108287). Paths resolve through scripts/uhi_paths.py, so the two records may be unpacked into one directory or kept apart.
